meta.title: Enable parallel simulation for AgentPopulation
meta.body_summary: Allow parallel execution in AgentPopulation.simulate with a one-time warning flag if parallel execution fails.

perf_labels.notes: Small PR adding parallel simulation via joblib with one-time warning flag; merged quickly after a correctness comment about pickling.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 30 changed lines in a single file, this is a very small edit by absolute volume. It fits a low-risk performance enhancement that merged quickly without blocking review.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer mnwhite noted that parallel execution will only fail if AgentType instance cannot be pickled, a narrow correctness edge case.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Parallel execution via joblib within AgentPopulation is within Python's multiprocessing capabilities; the only caution raised was about pickling, which Codex handled correctly.
